Description: "I will need your help." [If he has made two requests, you can fulfil either one.]
Name: The Venturer's Desires

Description: An urchin tugs your sleeve. "Guv'nor wants a word." A brooding figure waits at the lamp-light's edge.
Name: The Merchant Venturer

DefaultEvent.Description: "Thank you. This is perfect. I can buy cave-trout down at the docks any day of the week, but I'll need something a little different. Something for the shapelings. But now, I have further need of your services..."

ChildBranches.Name: "Something deep."
ChildBranches.Description: "Five hundred Echoes for seven peculiar fish-corpses. A very fine price." [You'll also get a check for the hassle]

DefaultEvent.Description: "This will do nicely. I need persuasive threats, not weapons - and these are persuasive. Now, I have further need of your services..."

ChildBranches.Name: "Something savage."
ChildBranches.Description: "I imagine you'll need to, ah, hunt things. Fierce things. Five hundred Echoes for seven pieces." [You'll also get a check for the hassle]

DefaultEvent.Description: "Thank you. Where I'm going... there will be light enough, eventually. But we'll need something we can manage ourselves. But now, I have further need of your services..."

ChildBranches.Name: "Something bright."
ChildBranches.Description: "Port Cecil, in the Principles of Coral. It's usually north-east, or thereabouts. That's where scintillack comes from. A round thousand Echoes, for seven." [You'll also get a check for the hassle]

DefaultEvent.Description: "There's something about the Revenue's touch. They don't change the words, but I never find the works quite so thrilling. Still, they're not for my eyes. Beyond the gate, there will be many appetites. I cannot even be sure how much use these will be - but I can hope. Now, something else..."

ChildBranches.Name: "Something romantic, and approved."
ChildBranches.Description: "They publish this stuff in the Khanate, to the East. But they don't trade readily... and there's a customs duty on love stories. Still, I'll pay a thousand Echoes for the seven." [You'll also get a check for the hassle]

DefaultEvent.Description: "Spiders. Spiders... they are the first to know the speech of stars. I will be the last. But I need something more..."

ChildBranches.Name: "Something silky."
ChildBranches.Description: "I'll offer you a better price than you'll get in Wolfstack. Much better. Five hundred Echoes for the lot. You'll find silk in Saviour's Rocks, far to the East. Or in the Khanate, near the zee's heart." [You'll also get a check for the hassle]

DefaultEvent.Description: "It's a specialist taste. But where I'm going, there are specialist customers. One more thing - "

ChildBranches.Name: "Something warming."
ChildBranches.Description: "They sell it in Mt Palmerston, somewhere in the North of the Unterzee. One thousand Echoes for seven sealed skins." [You'll also get a check for the hassle]

DefaultEvent.Description: "We won't need it for its taste. There are voices which must be drowned. Now -"
DefaultEvent.Teaser: "We won't need it for its taste...

ChildBranches.Name: "Something spicy."
ChildBranches.Description: "They harvest it in Whither, to the north along the coast. Seven hundred Echoes." [You'll also get a check for the hassle]

DefaultEvent.Description: "When I was a boy, I asked my nurse: when you break a law, what happens to the pieces? Now I know. Now I know. But I need something else - "
DefaultEvent.Teaser: "When I was a boy, I asked my nurse: when you break a law, what happens to the pieces?

ChildBranches.Name: "Something perilous."
ChildBranches.Description: "They sell these in Mt Palmerston, somewhere in the North of the Unterzee. Five hundred for seven barrels of the things. You won't find a better price." [You'll also get a check for the hassle]

DefaultEvent.Description: "Oh, thank you. Thank you. When I look at these, I want so much to travel again; but there's only one journey left in me, I think. You, on the other hand - "

ChildBranches.Name: "Something intricate."
ChildBranches.Description: "Find them in buried treasure, broken museums, pirate cargoes. Now and then, the stomachs of monsters. Good luck. I need seven. Don't ask why. Fifteen hundred Echoes will answer all your questions." [You'll also get a check for the hassle]

ChildBranches.Name: "Something forlorn."
ChildBranches.Description: "You can find it in Irem... or dreams. I don't know which is easier to find. (Actually, they sell it down at Wolfstack, but where's the romance in that? Or the profit.) Seven hundred Echoes for seven bales."  [You'll also get a check for the hassle]

DefaultEvent.Description: "All these are lessons. Contours of history. There will be scholars and marvellers... but enough of that. I have another task for you."

ChildBranches.Name: "Something durable."
ChildBranches.Description: "Murder enough monsters. Or you can purchase it in the Chelonate, far to the East. They're flooded with dead monsters. I'm not. Five hundred Echoes. Yes, it's generous. Be quick." [You'll also get a check for the hassle]

DefaultEvent.Description: "That blue! I will confess something to you. This is my least practical purchase - but I wanted something to remember the blue. Thank you. Cheap at the price. But there's something else - "

ChildBranches.Name: "Something azure."
ChildBranches.Description: "Sapphires, as of course you know, come from Port Carnelian, in the south-west of the zee. One thousand Echoes. There and back again. Hurry. I have candles to light." [You'll also get a check for the hassle]

DefaultEvent.Description: "The Flukes. The greatest of the shapelings. And the Lorns are the greatest of the Flukes. By accepting this Core, I make myself an accomplice in a crime... but perhaps, in a sense, this one will return home. Perhaps. One more thing - "

ChildBranches.Name: "Something... difficult."
ChildBranches.Description: "You, ah, might need to destroy a Lorn-Fluke - or find someone who already has. There's a thousand Echoes in it for you. One thousand. One thousand exactly. One thousand is the num - one thousand." [You'll also get a check for the hassle]

DefaultEvent.Description: "Seven. It's always seven. I don't know why. But if we are to profit by this scheme, we have to hew to the rules. We're close, now. But another thing - "

ChildBranches.Name: "Something sorrowful."
ChildBranches.Description: "We all know where to find human skulls. I appreciate that it can be difficult to negotiate for them. Five hundred Echoes... and no questions asked." [You'll also get a check for the hassle]

DefaultEvent.Description: "This will put fire in our belly. In all our bellies. We'll need that: it's cold out there. One more thing - "
DefaultEvent.Teaser: "This will put fire in our belly...

ChildBranches.Name: "Something dark."
ChildBranches.Description: "They grow it in the Elder Continent, to the South. You can find it in Adam's Way, or Port Carnelian, or the Khanate, perhaps. Seven hundred Echoes. Yes. Perhaps I just drink a lot of coffee."  [You'll also get a check for the hassle]

DefaultEvent.Description: "Beyond the gate, there will be many appetites. I cannot be sure how much use these will be - but I can hope. Now, something else..."
DefaultEvent.Teaser: "Beyond the gate, there will be many appetites...

ChildBranches.Name: "Something romantic, and smuggled."
ChildBranches.Description: "They publish this stuff in the Khanate, to the East. It may be difficult. They don't trade readily... and the Bazaar taxes love stories. I'll pay a thousand Echoes for the seven." [You'll also get a check for the hassle]

Description: "I will need your help." [AP version, each request will earn you a check]
Name: The Venturer's Desires (AP)
